professionalSummary.text: Develops embedded C for microcontroller-based appliance control boards.
professionalSummary.witness: Embedded software engineer at Ridgeway Appliances from January 2020 to February 2024, in the laundry-controls firmware team of seven, working on washing-machine and dryer control boards.

experienceHighlights.text: Writes unit tests and runs hardware-in-the-loop regression tests.
experienceHighlights.witness: Added unit tests with Unity and Ceedling and ran the hardware-in-the-loop regression suite on every firmware candidate, recording failures in the defect tracker.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Has led the firmware for a product platform, owning the architecture and release decisions.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: According to my department manager I was 'the firmware lead for the whole washer platform in practice' and 'made the release calls'.

skills.text: Supports hardware engineers during board bring-up.
skills.witness: Supported the hardware engineers during board bring-up, writing test firmware to exercise the sensors and the motor driver on the first prototype boards.
